intro.data: You already met one uniform conversion: safeHead turns a List into an Optional. Here's a second: 'As a List' turns an Optional into a List (the one item, or empty). Do one then the other and you get a SINGLE conversion, List ⇒ List — that's vertical composition. At each type, its component is just the two component arrows composed. Pick the composed conversion (one candidate composes them faithfully; the other splices in a default and isn't natural).
intro.alchemy: One uniform method takes F to G; a second takes G to H. Done one after the other they give a SINGLE method, F ⇒ H — vertical composition. At each material, its component is the two component steps composed. Pick the composed method; the other splices in a spare and isn't natural.
intro.spellcraft: One uniform working takes F to G; a second takes G to H. Cast one then the other and you get a SINGLE working, F ⇒ H — vertical composition. At each essence, its component is the two component runes composed. Choose the composed working; the other splices in a conjured one and isn't natural.
intro.abstract: Given α : F ⇒ G and β : G ⇒ H, build the vertical composite β·α : F ⇒ H. Its component at A is β_A ∘ α_A. Pick that composite at each object; a non-composite, non-natural family is offered as a distractor.

afterSuccess.data: You stacked two conversions into one: safeHead (List⇒Optional) then 'As a List' (Optional⇒List) gives a single List⇒List conversion, and its component at each type is just the two component arrows composed — (β·α)_A = β_A ∘ α_A. The 'Default, As a List' family spliced in a default and broke the square. Natural transformations compose, end to end.
afterSuccess.alchemy: You stacked two methods into one: F⇒G then G⇒H gives a single F⇒H method, its component the two steps composed — (β·α)_A = β_A ∘ α_A. The spare-splicing family broke the square.
afterSuccess.spellcraft: You stacked two workings into one: F⇒G then G⇒H gives a single F⇒H working, its component the two runes composed — (β·α)_A = β_A ∘ α_A. The conjuring family broke the square.
afterSuccess.abstract: β·α : F ⇒ H is natural, with (β·α)_A = β_A ∘ α_A; the non-composite family fails naturality. Vertical composition of natural transformations is itself a natural transformation.

reveal.summary: Vertical composition: natural transformations stack end to end. If α : F ⇒ G and β : G ⇒ H, then β·α : F ⇒ H is natural, with component (β·α)_A = β_A ∘ α_A at each object.
reveal.programmerAnalogy: Composing two polymorphic conversions: (xs => safeHead(xs)) then (o => o.toList()).
